caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica will eventually ask you to get off and push. The elevation here isn't gradual; trails climb directly through rainforest ridgelines where mud and gradient combine to test patience as much as legs. There is no shame in walking alongside your frame — in the high country, every metre earned forward is honest work. Send this to the friend who knows the value of a hike-a-bike.
